version_metadata.description:
Hands-Free Vocab is the premier audio-first, voice-controlled English vocabulary learning app designed specifically for commuters, drivers, and busy professionals.

COMMUTE-FIRST VOCABULARY ENGINE:
Master 1,800 collegiate, executive, and competitive-examination words across 60 progressive study sets without looking at or touching your screen. Listen to crisp acoustic phonetic hooks, definitions, real-world contextual usage, and classical Latin/Greek etymologies directly through your car's Bluetooth audio or phone speaker.

100% HANDS-FREE VOICE CONTROL:
Control your entire study session completely hands-free with real-time on-device speech recognition:
• "Next" or "Skip" — Advance immediately to the next vocabulary card.
• "Repeat" or "Again" — Replay the phonetic pronunciation hook.
• "Mastered" or "Got It" — Flag the word as mastered, update spaced repetition intervals, and advance.
• "Explain" or "Detail" — Hear the full, comprehensive lexical breakdown and usage nuances.
• "Example" or "Sentence" — Spoken narration of real-world contextual application.
• "Root" or "Origin" — Explore morphological word family roots and classical origins.
• "Pause" / "Resume" — Seamlessly manage audio pauses at red lights or during phone calls.

CONTINUOUS CROSS-SET AUTOPLAY:
Study continuously from the first module to the last. When a 30-word set finishes, the app announces your milestone, pauses for two seconds, and smoothly rolls into the next set for uninterrupted driving practice.

FOUR SPECIALIZED VOCABULARY TRACKS:
• Executive & Orator: Persuasive leadership, negotiation, and high-stakes discourse.
• GRE & Polymath: Advanced academic, analytical, and competitive examination lexicon.
• Classic Literary: Prose, aesthetic nuance, and evocative literary expression.
• Medicolegal & Nuance: Precision terminology, forensic rigor, and scholarly clarity.

NATURAL SPEECH & SIRI SHORTCUTS:
• Expressive Voices: Choose between calibrated Natural Female and Natural Male voices with humanized conversational cadence.
• Siri Integration: Simply say "Hey Siri, start Hands-Free Vocab" to launch your commute study session hands-free.

PRIVACY FIRST & ZERO DISTRACTION:
Speech processing is computed entirely on your device. Zero audio transmission, zero external tracking, zero ads, and zero account logins required.
version_metadata.promotional_text: Master 1,800 collegiate and executive vocabulary words 100% hands-free with voice recognition designed for daily driving and commuters.

app_review_information.review_notes:
Hands-Free Vocab is an audio-first, hands-free vocabulary learning application created specifically for drivers, commuters, and hands-busy learners. Zero account, login, or subscriptions required. Operates completely offline with 1,800 bundled words and on-device speech recognition.

HOW APP REVIEWER CAN TEST HANDS-FREE VOICE CONTROLS IN 10 SECONDS:
1. Tap any track (e.g., Executive & Orator). The app immediately begins spoken acoustic playback.
2. Say aloud 'Explain' — the app will immediately narrate the in-depth definition and usage nuances.
3. Say aloud 'Next' — the app instantly advances to the next vocabulary card without touching the screen.
4. Say aloud 'Mastered' — the app flags the word as mastered, updates the Spaced Repetition queue, and advances.
5. Say aloud 'Root' — the app narrates the classical Latin/Greek etymology.
(Note: Speech recognition runs 100% on-device via SFSpeechRecognizer and a dedicated AVAudioEngine tap with 0ms cloud latency).

ORIGINALITY & APP STORE GUIDELINE 4.3 DEFENSE:
Prior to architecture, an extensive competitive audit was conducted against App Store vocabulary products (Magoosh, Vocabulary.com, Elevate, WordUp). All existing apps rely strictly on visual touch interactions (tapping multiple-choice buttons or swiping cards), making them impossible to use while driving.

Hands-Free Vocab is a completely novel audio and voice product tailored specifically for commute safety:
1. On-Device Speech Recognition Engine (VoiceCommander.swift): Uses SFSpeechRecognizer and a dedicated AVAudioEngine tap with intelligent debounce to recognize driving commands ('Next', 'Repeat', 'Mastered', 'Explain', 'Example', 'Root') silently on-device with zero network latency.
2. Acoustic Session Orchestrator (VoiceManager.swift): Employs a specialized .playAndRecord session with .defaultToSpeaker and automatic speech-pause coordination, preventing microphone ducking and audio feedback loops.
3. Continuous Autonomous Progression: Cycles through 60 progressive 30-word sets (1,800 words total) with spoken milestone transition announcements and calibrated cognitive pauses.
4. Siri App Intents (VocabAppIntents.swift): Allows full eyes-free session initiation ('Hey Siri, start Hands-Free Vocab').

All Swift code, audio scheduling algorithms, and 1,800-word curricula are completely original proprietary code.
